items.facts: Updated label for Unnamed product (). why_it_matters.text: These actions directly impact pharma teams monitoring product quality and safety, as highlighted by particulate matter contamination in nipocalimab-aahu injection and bacterial endotoxin out-of-specification findings in compounded formulations.
